findings.explanation: The endpoint does not verify ownership of the user being filtered, allowing unauthorized access to other users' data.

evidence.content:
- A user may read or update ONLY their own profile (`/users/<id>`).
  Administrators may read or update any profile. Use
  `is_owner_or_admin(current_user, user_id)` for this check.

findings.suggested_fix: Add an ownership check to ensure the current user is either the owner of the user being filtered or an administrator.
